caption: This shoyu ramen features a rich, amber broth with tender chashu pork and menma bamboo shoots. Fresh green onions crown the noodles in a white ceramic bowl, set against a warm wooden table under soft, inviting light.

segments_info.text: Dark brown wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and smooth texture.
Chashu pork slice: golden-brown, slightly glossy, with tender texture and irregular edges, showing faint marbling and surface sheen.
The shoyu (soy sauce) broth is golden-brown, glossy, and slightly frothy, swirling around noodles and green onions.
Menma bamboo shoots appear golden-brown, slightly translucent, with a soft, fibrous texture and curved, elongated shape.
White ceramic bowl with smooth, glossy surface, slightly curved rim, and subtle light reflections.
